I worked through `python3 -B -I` helpers `.session/artifacts/show.py` and `find.py`.

## Findings
- Draft plan saved at `.session/artifacts/step4-patch.md`. It has exact old and new text for four Edits to `benchmark/scripts/score.py` (lines 311-319, 337, 344-345, 352-353), which add `wrong-literal-a0001` (`20008001`) and `wrong-locator-a0002` (`Property[3]`).
- F4: the inventory has A0001 at lines 323 and 330-331 (`/Library/@LVVersion`) and A0002 at lines 357 and 364-365 (`/Library/Property[4]/@Name`). Both use `scheme: xml-positional-path`. `xpath-positional` appears nowhere in score.py.
- `citation_support` (score.py:74) tests whole-dict membership in `key['citations']`, so the scheme is compared only as part of the dict. The literal is compared by exact equality at score.py:207.

## Not done
- score.py lines 381-430 (the rest of `generate()`, the flags, the regeneration command) were not read.
- The control's A0001 and A0002 claim entries in `benchmark/challenges/library-specialty.json` were not read.
- The #828, #831 and #848 reports under `.session/exports/reports/` were not opened.
- The verification command and `git status --porcelain` were not run. `.session/artifacts/show.py` and `find.py` are untracked and may show up in git status.
- No repository file was changed.

## What next
Apply the plan only after a short session reads score.py 380-430 and the control's A0001/A0002 claims, and confirms the regeneration command with `--help`. Use `python3 -B -I .session/artifacts/show.py <file> <a> <b>` if Read is disabled again.
